doc: The values dcp_save's defaults held until 2026-10-23 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): 4 write items per rank of 16, 32, 16, and 8 MiB, a 2 MiB .metadata, a checkpoint every 100 of 500 steps of 323 ms. Placeholders, not measured: no job stands behind them (the 2026-10-01 trace behind the abstract is the example toy-6-items).
